name: scripthub-electron

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --projectDir apps/electron --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit && tsc -p apps/electron --noEmit
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --projectDir apps/electron --config electron-builder.yml --win dir
scripts.e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config apps/electron/e2e/vitest.config.ts

description: ScriptHub: discover, configure, run and monitor Python/Bash/batch scripts locally or over SSH. Electron desktop app with a TypeScript engine.
author: Dhiraj Bajracharya
